articles.body: I read and re-read the rules and reference cards, but I'm still not certain. You check for losses when deploying, and during officer rout in Region Loss, but if you exhaust an officer to defend an attack on the company, do you roll to check for losses on those officers?

articles.body:
[q="BryanPost"]I read and re-read the rules and reference cards, but I'm still not certain. You check for losses when deploying, and during officer rout in Region Loss, but if you exhaust an officer to defend an attack on the company, do you roll to check for losses on those officers?[/q]

You only check for loses if the attack was successful (i.e the defend value was not enough and the company lost), in which case you perform the whole "Region loss" routine.

articles.body:
Does the region loss roll apply to all officers in the presidency, or only ones that could be exhausted in the defence? 
In other words, do officers already used that turn make a second death roll?

I've been playing "no", but realise that the double death risk seems a fitting punishment for such reckless adventuring.
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Does the region loss roll apply to all officers in the presidency, or only ones that could be exhausted in the defence? <br/>In other words, do officers already used that turn make a second death roll?<br/><br/>I've been playing "no", but realise that the double death risk seems a fitting punishment for such reckless adventuring.</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
[q="Hangsi"]Does the region loss roll apply to all officers in the presidency, or only ones that could be exhausted in the defence? 
In other words, do officers already used that turn make a second death roll?

I've been playing "no", but realise that the double death risk seems a fitting punishment for such reckless adventuring.[/q]

Yes, you roll for every officer. It is mentioned in step 2 of Region Loss (Officer Rout).

Think of it as although those already exhausted were resting in the army office and didn't participate in the attempt to suppress the attack, the rioters don't care what each officer was doing, they just want to terminate everything that's company related.
